title: Earlier iteration (22 Oct, first run) — Bundled ChartSearchAI or the Hub, on one shared 12B engine
summary: The Hub answer-only setup failed every question on a profile error, so its zero scores are not a result. Bundled also read the question-scoped slice.
takeaway: On the same engine, the Hub's plain answer path scored 78.9 and bundled ChartSearchAI 59.8. The gap comes from things the bundled path does not have: it does not tell the model today's date, it has no guideline knowledge base or date checks, and its repetition penalty garbles long lists when it reads the whole chart. The checked profile (78.4) was the most complete but marked most In-Depth sections red, mostly guideline statements that cite a chart record which does not back them.
